bead.title: builtin registry New(claude) must honor FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT like execute dispatch
bead.description:
PROBLEM: internal/harnesses/builtin/registry.go:17 constructs &claudeharness.Runner{} for the \"claude\" case with NativeMode always false, ignoring the FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT knob that internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go honors (claudeNativeTransportSelected at :30, newClaudeRunner at :37). Any code path that builds the claude harness via builtin.New (rather than execute dispatch's newClaudeRunner) silently gets the subprocess runner even when native is selected — a latent wrong-transport inconsistency.

ROOT CAUSE: registry.go:16-17 hard-codes &claudeharness.Runner{} with no transport selection; the selection logic lives ONLY in serviceimpl (execute_dispatch.go).

PROPOSED FIX: Make the claude case in builtin/registry.go New() honor the same transport selection. To avoid an import cycle (builtin must NOT import serviceimpl), move the env-read selection helper out of execute_dispatch.go into a location both can import — e.g. export claudeharness.NativeTransportSelected() in the claude harness package (internal/harnesses/claude) — and call it from BOTH execute_dispatch.go (newClaudeRunner) and builtin/registry.go. Single source of truth for the env read.

NON-SCOPE: do NOT change the env var name (FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT) or its default (subprocess). Do NOT flip the default.
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test TestBuiltinNewClaudeHonorsTransport (internal/harnesses/builtin/registry_test.go): with FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT=native, New(\"claude\") returns a Runner with NativeMode=true; unset/default returns NativeMode=false.
2. execute_dispatch.go and builtin/registry.go share ONE transport-selection function (no duplicated env-read); existing TestClaudeTransportSelection still passes.
3. No import cycle: GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go build ./... is clean.
4. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/... ./internal/serviceimpl/... -count=1 -timeout 150s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS).
5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
